args.title: Validate calendar dates in report from/to fields
args.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

The `isoDate` zod schema only checks the YYYY-MM-DD shape with a regex, so calendar-invalid dates like "2027-02-29" or "2026-04-31" pass validation and are sent straight to reportRepo.create's INSERT, where Postgres rejects them with error code 22008 and the request fails with an unhandled 500.

Change `isoDate` to also verify the date is a real calendar date (e.g. by refining the regex match with a check that round-trips through Date/UTC and compares year/month/day), so an invalid date is rejected by the existing zod validation in the POST and PATCH /reports handlers and surfaces as a 400 naming the field, before it ever reaches the database.

label: bug
file: src/api/reports.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The `isoDate` zod schema (used by both the create and update schemas) only checks the YYYY-MM-DD shape with a regex; it doesn't verify the date is a real calendar date. So "2027-02-29" and "2026-04-31" pass validation and reach `reportRepo.create`'s INSERT, where Postgres raises "date/time field value out of range" (22008), which isn't caught anywhere and surfaces as an unhandled 500. The schema should refine the regex check with an actual calendar-date check so invalid dates get rejected as a 400 before hitting the database.
